focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of the printed text/logo on the puck face.
Sharpness and continuity of the circumferential ridges on the side.
Boundary definition between the puck and the wooden background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the puck. AI generators often produce gibberish or warped letters. If the text is perfectly legible and geometrically consistent with the puck's perspective, it is a strong signal of high quality. Also, verify that the ridges on the side do not 'melt' into the top face.

The top face features a colorful printed logo with text '2016' and 'NHL DRAFT', along with other smaller text. The side profile shows the characteristic ridged texture of the rubber edge. The lighting creates a soft shadow to the left.
